name: BT.Finance Curve aave-pool strategies unbounded slippage
summary: BT.Finance's StrategyUSDTCurve and StrategyUSDCCurve value their Curve aave-pool LP at get_virtual_price() but enter and exit the pool with add_liquidity(..., 0, true) and remove_liquidity_one_coin(..., 0, true), with no slippage bound, and the strategy deposit() and vault earn() that push vault funds into the pool are callable by anyone. With flash-loaned DAI the attacker unbalanced the pool, pushed its own and the vault's idle USDT/USDC into it at the distorted rate, restored the pool and redeemed its vault shares through freshly created helper contracts, so the slippage fell on existing depositors. Five transactions cut the USDT vault's balance() from 1,415,603.715775 to 525,985.069294 and the USDC vault's from 2,625,707.869159 to 882,227.990952 while share supplies stayed unchanged.

loss.notes: Depositor loss measured by each vault's own balance() (idle token plus strategy want plus gauge-staked a3CRV at get_virtual_price) between block 11817851 and block 11817869 with totalSupply unchanged: bUSDT vault 0x3ec4a6cfe803ee84009ce6e1ecf419c9cb1e8af0 1,415,603.715775 -> 525,985.069294 USDT (getPricePerFullShare 1.004921 -> 0.373391), USDC vault 0x8d702f8c5304c9d233a8a23fd3a22155e15bb357 2,625,707.869159 -> 882,227.990952 USDC (1.033299 -> 0.347185). The strategies' a3CRV-gauge balances fall by 667,796.22 (USDT) and 1,732,938.27 (USDC) over the five legs. The attacker's net proceeds are 1,381,896.996183609 DAI (0x66c7a0c6 sweep to the EOA); the remainder of the depositor loss stayed in the Curve aave pool as imbalance value (get_virtual_price 1.015670 -> 1.025644). DefiLlama dates the event 2021-02-12 at 1.5M USD, which is the attacker's proceeds; the onchain campaign is 2021-02-08.

ageReset.description: The BT team Safe 0x5dc224fa0aef9bada1201e05bf978671f9c0be6b executed setStrategy(USDT, 0x7865ee2a...) on Controller 0x03d2079c54967f463fd6e89e76012f74ebc62615, writing strategies[USDT] (mapping slot 4) from zero. Only from this write did the USDT vault's earn and withdraw route through this strategy; the pointer is unchanged through block 11817856.

The same Safe's setStrategy(USDC, 0x8934c0d7...) replaced StrategyUSDCPickle 0x15ba709f87da04b6140892b3baec8f710cdf67d8 with this Curve strategy in Controller strategies[USDC]; unchanged through block 11817856.

limitations: Sibling of target-1 (same defect, USDC constants, distinct runtime); its activation at block 11747921 precedes target-1's at 11747930, so target-1 carries the knot.

sources.note: Targets: Etherscan-verified StrategyUSDTCurve 0x7865ee2a and StrategyUSDCCurve 0x8934c0d7 (creator 0x5e1f55a4a02890cf7d599a8d39cb5e4cdbef3aea, BT token deployer) have public deposit() calling add_liquidity([0,0,usdt] / [0,usdc,0], 0, true) on Curve aave pool 0xdebf20617708857ebe4f679508e7b7863a8a8eee, _withdrawSome sizing a3CRV by get_virtual_price then remove_liquidity_one_coin(_a3CRV, i, 0, true), and balanceOf() = want + (gauge + a3CRV) * get_virtual_price / 1e30. eth_getCode is empty at 11747799/11747791 and hashes to the declared codeHash at 11747800/11747792 and 11817856. Activation: Controller strategies mapping is slot 4 (governance, timelock, rewards, vaults, strategies); eth_getStorageAt bisection over 11747800-11817851 shows strategies[USDT] 0 -> 0x7865ee2a first at 11747930 (tx 0x3bc07727, index 173, Safe execTransaction 0x6a761202 from 0x5e1f55a4) and strategies[USDC] 0x15ba709f -> 0x8934c0d7 first at 11747921 (tx 0x01d3769b, index 28); both values equal at 11817851. Ages: 1612815123 - 1611884970 = 930,153 s; 1612815123 - 1611884849 = 930,274 s. Vault bVault 0x3ec4a6cf: earn() public, deposit() mints shares on balance(), RestrictContractCall true (bypassed by helper contracts acting in their constructors) and a 60 s per-address deposit/withdraw gap (bypassed by transferring shares to fresh helpers). Earlier-exercise scan: getPricePerFullShare of both vaults is non-decreasing at blocks 11748000, 11760000, 11780000, 11800000, 11810000, 11817000 and 11817851 except one USDC-vault step at 11748322 (1.027222 -> 1.026100), the ordinary deposit 0x2ecffafd by 0x1fe5f397e38ffe61e663d96821f41bcf83ed7959 with no pool manipulation and no gain; the attacker's earlier txs 0xc71cea6f (11817852) and 0x59445280 (11817853) move no vault, strategy or a3CRV-gauge balance.

Anchor: EOA 0x358abccb4f5bb715482271890929fdabb3015878 deployed attack contract 0x54b5ae5ebe86d2d86134f3bb7e36e7c83295cbcb (0xf792f288, block 11817848) and called 0x9a8341d1 in 0xa109ecf3 (11817857:10, ts 1612815123, status 1, 254 logs). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): helper 0xa10b8009 adds single-sided DAI liquidity and removes via remove_liquidity_one_coin to unbalance the pool, deposits into the USDC vault (auto-earn -> stratUSDC.deposit -> add_liquidity with min 0) and into bUSDT plus bUSDT.earn() (-> stratUSDT.deposit -> add_liquidity min 0), rebalances, then transfers shares to fresh helpers 0x58f0c013/0x879b5163 whose withdrawAll routes Controller.withdraw -> strategy remove_liquidity_one_coin(min 0); the cycle runs twice per tx. The same selector repeats in 0x7b88a698 (11817860:0), 0x0a51749d (11817863:1), 0x82f95242 (11817866:5) and 0xb4666cc0 (11817869:7, ts 1612815245); 0x66c7a0c6 (11817870:215) sweeps 1,381,896.996183609 DAI to the EOA. Loss: eth_call balance()/totalSupply()/getPricePerFullShare() on both vaults at 11817851, 11817856, 11817869 and 11817900 give the notes' values; totalSupply is 1,408,671.328350 (bUSDT) and 2,541,091.599355 (USDC vault) throughout. Receipt Transfer sums of a3CRV-gauge 0xd662908ada2ea1916b3318327a97eb18ad588b5d out of the strategies per leg: USDT 10,199.29 / 199,061.07 / 177,046.52 / 152,937.29 / 128,552.05; USDC 450,875.24 / 399,208.22 / 348,192.48 / 293,950.83 / 240,711.49.
